proof_check: computer-assisted (Python) - theorems CLM-C03-01/02 for the terminating rules; explicit loop certificates (forward closures, strategies, mirror images) re-checked step by step for the non-terminating ones
statement:
Among the 625 rules 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s with p, q, r, s <= 5, the 525 with s <= p or r <= q terminate and 76
(listed in results/EXP-C03-02.json and EXP-C03-03.json) are non-terminating; the remaining 24 are open here.
title: Classification of 601 of the 625 rules with p, q, r, s <= 5 (computer-assisted)
